hotel.name: The St Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort

verified_facts.text: Es Fum is a Michelin-starred restaurant with a Sol Repsol, where chef Miguel Navarro cooks facing the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Es Fum, a Michelin-starred restaurant in Mallorca with a Sol Repsol, where chef Miguel Navarro creates flavors without borders facing the Mediterranean.

verified_facts.text: The resort is spread over four terracotta-toned buildings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spread over four terracotta-toned buildings, the 125 rooms and suites have large private terraces with access to the garden or overlooking the Mediterranean.

verified_facts.text: Each room and suite has a private terrace or balcony, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea or the resort's gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: each overlooking the Mediterranean Sea or the resort's lush gardens. Each accommodation has a private terrace or balcony, ideal for alfresco dining, toasting with friends or simply relaxing.

verified_facts.text: St. Regis Butler service is provided in all room types.
Some residences, such as the St. Regis Pool Residence, have a private pool at garden level.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Residence, 1 King, Garden view, Garden level, Private pool

verified_facts.text: The spa blends Eastern and Western therapies and includes Egyptian brine baths and an ice cave.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spa blends Eastern and Western therapies with a holistic approach, 11 treatment rooms, whirlpool, dry sauna, Egyptian brine baths, ice cave and fitness center.

verified_facts.text: Mar Sea Club has a beachfront location and sea views, serving Mediterranean and Latin American flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mar Sea Club welcomes you with Mallorca-inspired design, a privileged beachfront location and sea views, where Mediterranean and Latin American flavors meet.

verified_facts.text: Terra serves island flavors under the theme 'Recipes and products of Mallorca'.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Terra's authentic island flavors with "Recipes and products of Mallorca", served in an elegant dining room inspired by the island's natural beauty.

verified_facts.text: The resort's own Bloody Mary is the Mardavall Snapper, infused with island flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the Mardavall Snapper, infused with the vibrant flavors of the island.

verified_facts.text: Sabrage, the art of opening champagne with a saber, is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals, offered as a sunset celebration at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: the art of sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals series. Experience your own sunset celebration at the St. Regis Mardavall.

verified_facts.text: The Explorers Club offers daily programming for children; children who solve its tasks receive an Explorer's Certificate.
verified_facts.excerpt: All children that have successfully solved the different tasks will receive at the end of their stay the title of "Official Explorer” as well as an Explorer’s Certificate signed by the Exploration Leader and a special surprise.

verified_facts.text: Parents must remain on resort premises while their children attend the Explorers Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: parents or caretakers must remain on resort premises at all times while their children are attending the Club.

verified_facts.text: A sandy beach is about 15 minutes' walk or 5 minutes' drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a beautiful sandy beach located within 15 minutes walking distance or 5 minutes drive from St Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is on the Carretera Palma-Andratx in Costa d'en Blanes, Palma de Mallorca.
verified_facts.excerpt: Carretera Palma-Andratx 19, Costa d'en Blanes, Palma de Mallorca, Spain, 07181

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Dogs and cats up to 11 kg are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: We warmly welcome pets (dogs and cats) up to 11 kg at The St. Regis Mardavall.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a helicopter and private yacht excursion to Isla del Rey in Menorca.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Mallorca from above before crossing over to the enchanting island of Menorca. Upon arrival, embark on a private yacht to explore the captivating ‘sla del Rey

verified_facts.text: Es Fum offers an experience with a visit to Chef Miguel Navarro's private garden, a wine tasting with the sommelier and the Origen tasting menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: wander through his private garden, savor a thoughtfully curated wine tasting with the sommelier, and indulge in the exquisite Origen tasting menu

verified_facts.text: In collaboration with Gallery Red, the resort shows contemporary art benefiting the Mallorca Preservation Foundation.
verified_facts.excerpt: benefiting the Mallorca Preservation Foundation, which will receive a share from the artworks sold.
